messages:
Nina C: quick thread We need a short battlecard addendum for the webinar: one-liner rebuttals vs cloud platforms, LLM APIs, infra vendors. keep field-ready and low-jargon.
Omar V: Sales wants 1-line SDR leads + a 2-line email version. Avoid hard numbers unless lab appendix linked.
Priya S: draft snippets:
- Cloud platforms: "Stable production latency via engineered routing and reserved pools."
- LLM APIs: "Same API contract; lower unit cost with automated batching & prefix caching."
- Infra vendors: "Inference as a product: runtime, rollouts, and tracing included."
Evan R: tweak LLM APIs: replace "prefix caching" with "response-prefix caching" for clarity. Also add an FAQ bullet on SLAs and private deployments.
Priya S: adding FAQ: 
Q: Private deployment options? A: Yes 1 VPC and on-prem packages; KMS integrations supported.
Nina C: final ask Produce short/e-mail/slide variants by EOD and link the bench appendix when Ravi uploads it. ops-bot: shared doc created https://docs.google.com/document/d/EXAMPLE (marketing/battlecards/addendum)
Omar V: I'll run a quick field test with two SDRs tomorrow morning.
Priya S: will drop variants into the doc within the hour.
